nodes.description: Public pure function of migrateOS that validates a BubbleBudz id by comparing the upper 96 bits against a hardcoded address-like constant and checking the low 40 bits equal 1 via bitwise shift/mask.
Public pure function of migrateOS that derives a genesis id by masking/shifting tokenId_ and subtracting 2 from the intermediate value, then returning the result.
Caller-supplied identifier argument consumed by isValidBubbleBudz and used in bitwise shift/mask comparisons.
Caller-supplied token identifier argument consumed by bubbleBudsGenesisId to compute the raw masked id.
Intermediate value obtained by masking tokenId_ with 0x...ffffffffffffff0000000000 and right-shifting by 40 bits.
Final computed value returned by bubbleBudsGenesisId, equal to _rawId minus 2.
Arithmetic subtraction (_rawId - 2) performed on a caller-influenced value; underflows/reverts under ^0.8.0 checked arithmetic.

edges.reason: The parameter id_ is read directly by isValidBubbleBudz inside its bitwise validation checks.
The parameter tokenId_ is the sole input consumed by bubbleBudsGenesisId to compute the returned id.
_rawId is derived from tokenId_ through a mask and a 40-bit right shift.
The intermediate _rawId feeds the subtraction _rawId - 2, which can underflow for small raw ids.
The result of the subtraction operation is stored into the local _fixedId.
bubbleBudsGenesisId unconditionally executes the subtraction operation on every call.
The local _fixedId is returned as the output value of bubbleBudsGenesisId.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter id_ exists only to feed the pure validation logic of isValidBubbleBudz and has no independent identity, so it is folded into that core function.
The parameter tokenId_ is used exclusively by bubbleBudsGenesisId to derive the returned id and can be merged into that core function node.
_rawId is a temporary value that exists only as the left operand of the subtraction operation, so it is merged into that core unsafe_operation node.
_fixedId is a temporary value whose only purpose is to be returned by bubbleBudsGenesisId, so it is merged into that core function node.
